{
  "image_ref": "img-k7",
  "observations": [
    {
      "locus": "the smooth surface of the face and neck",
      "visible_organization": "The features are carved with a gentle, flowing contour. A single light source from above and to the left creates a soft gradient across the forehead, nose, and cheek, leaving subtle shadows under the brow and along the jawline.",

      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "the sculpted locks of hair framing the face",
      "visible_organization": "The hair is rendered in individual, rounded waves and curls that follow the curve of the head. These forms create a series of small ridges and valleys.",

      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "the fabric draped over the chest and shoulder",
      "visible_organization": "The drapery is carved to show deep, diagonal folds that converge towards the center of the torso. The cloth appears heavy, with defined creases and overlapping layers.",

      "apparent_material_effect": "This suggests a rigid material, like stone, that has been carved to imitate the softness and drape of fabric. The smooth transitions within the folds imply a high level of craftsmanship in the carving technique.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "the background behind the bust",
      "visible_organization": "A solid, dark field that is not sharply defined at its edges. It appears to be out of focus or intentionally blurred.",
      "surface_light_behavior": "The surface is non-reflective and absorbs almost all incident light, appearing uniformly dark from the top corners downwards with a slight gradient towards the bottom right.",
      "apparent_material_effect": "This appearance is typical of a controlled studio environment using a black backdrop or a dark room corner to isolate the subject. It provides high contrast that defines the silhouette of the object.",
      "uncertainty": "medium",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "the surface upon which the bust rests",
      "visible_organization": "A flat, horizontal plane visible at the bottom edge of the frame.",
      "surface_light_behavior": "The surface is dark and non-reflective. A soft shadow cast by the object falls across it, indicating that light is coming from above and that this surface is slightly recessed or further back in space than the object itself.",
      "apparent_material_effect": "The appearance suggests a dark, matte floor or plinth. It acts as a base for the sculpture but does not distract from it due to its lack of texture or reflection.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    }
  ],
  "cannot_determine": [
    "the physical dimensions of the bust",
    "the exact distance between the camera and the subject",
    "the precise material composition of the object beyond visual appearance",
    "whether the photograph was taken in a natural or artificial environment"

{
  "image_ref": "img-v9",
  "observations": [
    {
      "locus": "entire image frame",
      "visible_organization": "the subject is a bust of a figure, filling most of the frame against a solid black background. the head and shoulders are oriented towards the viewer, with the face angled slightly downward.",
      "surface_light_behavior": "strong directional lighting originates from the upper left, creating bright highlights on the left side of the drapery and forehead, while casting the right side of the face and neck in deep shadow.",
      "apparent_material_effect": "the surface appears smooth and reflective, consistent with polished stone such as marble. the light catches gently on the convex surfaces of the face and the ridges of the cloth folds.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "figure's head and hair",
      "visible_organization": "the hair is arranged in flowing strands that sweep across the face from left to right. deep shadowing obscures the details behind the draped veil.",
      "surface_light_behavior": "light reflects evenly off the high points of the carved strands, suggesting a hard but slightly translucent material where light penetrates and scatters internally before emerging.",
      "apparent_material_effect": "the appearance resembles stone that has been polished to a semi-translucent state. it lacks the specular gloss of modern glass or plastic, possessing an inner depth rather than just a surface shine.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "figure's facial features",

      "apparent_material_effect": "the texture appears soft and solid, consistent with carved material. there is no visible sign of painted surface or organic porosity (like pores).",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },

      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    }
  ],

    "the actual material composition (e.g., marble vs. plaster vs. resin)",
    "any maker or signature associated with the object",
    "the age or date of the work",
    "specific cultural origin beyond general appearance"
  ]
}
